scope: Current NCCP sources compared 2026-10-21; source/software review only, not independent clinical authorisation

00350.title: Pertuzumab and Trastuzumab with Chemotherapy

monitoring.baseline: HER2 positive, FBC/renal/liver profile, LVEF by echo/MUGA (p3). Chemotherapy-specific tests follow chosen companion source.
monitoring.ongoing: Echo/MUGA every 12 weeks; 4–8 weeks may be appropriate if cardiac impairment. At 21-day cycles, first planned 12-week echo is around cycle 5 if uninterrupted. Surgery does not reset this clock.
monitoring.imaging: NCCP leaves disease monitoring to the individual treatment plan and consultant. No automatic 3-monthly CT/TAP or tumour-marker surveillance is specified. Response imaging during neoadjuvant treatment is separately planned; postoperative surveillance follows the selected pathway.
monitoring.ecg: The source TESTS section does not explicitly prescribe a baseline ECG. Any baseline ECG recommendation needs separate cardio-oncology attribution.
monitoring.blood: FBC, renal and liver profile before each 21-day antibody cycle (p3); extra checks follow companion chemotherapy.

indication.neoadjuvant: Adult high-risk HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer; source 00350a records ODMS 01/07/2020.
indication.adjuvant: Adult HER2-positive early breast cancer at high recurrence risk; source 00350b explicitly says pertuzumab reimbursement not approved. Do not imply routine Irish access; check separately.

00350.sequence: Antibody framework, not a defined chemotherapy backbone. Select companion NCCP chemotherapy regimen. If anthracyclines used, complete them before both antibodies. If taxane used, start both antibodies on first taxane-cycle Day 1. Neoadjuvant antibodies q21 days for 3–6 cycles, surgery then source lists adjuvant trastuzumab to complete one year. Adjuvant antibody strategy is up to 18 q21-day cycles / one year, stopping earlier if progression or unacceptable toxicity.
00350.schedule: Pertuzumab 840 mg IV loading then 420 mg q21 days. Trastuzumab 8 mg/kg IV loading then 6 mg/kg q21 days. No named chemotherapy dose or days can be inferred from this card.
00350.eligibility: HER2 positive, ECOG 0–1; baseline LVEF ≥55%, or ≥50% after completed anthracycline chemotherapy.

support.risk: Minimal for the antibodies only. Combined-visit emetic risk, premedication, G-CSF and blood thresholds must come from the selected chemotherapy regimen.
support.premedication: No routine antibody premedication unless previous hypersensitivity; consider paracetamol/antihistamine as directed.

administration.detail: First pertuzumab 60-minute infusion plus one-hour observation; subsequent 30-minute infusion if tolerated (consultant may choose 30–60 min), 30–60-minute observation, not required after three consecutive tolerated treatments per source. Trastuzumab first 90-minute infusion, later 30 minutes. Source observation at least 6 hours from start of first trastuzumab infusion and 2 hours from subsequent starts; local deviations documented.

cardiac_rule.during_treatment: Hold HER2 therapy if current LVEF<50% AND decrease≥10 percentage points. Review/repeat after about3weeks; abnormal historical baseline is not a new current measurement.
cardiac_rule.heart_failure: 00258 says consider discontinuation, cardiology and clinical decision; other four sources say discontinue for symptomatic heart failure.

00775.title: Pertuzumab, Trastuzumab, Paclitaxel and Carboplatin (TRAIN-2)

monitoring.baseline: FBC, renal/liver profile and cardiac assessment; HER2 positivity verified. For carboplatin, measured isotope GFR preferred or suitable GFR/CrCl estimation.
monitoring.ongoing: Echo/MUGA every 12 weeks; 4–8 weeks may be appropriate if cardiac impairment. At 21-day cycles, first planned 12-week echo is around cycle 5 if uninterrupted. Surgery does not reset this clock.
monitoring.imaging: NCCP leaves disease monitoring to the individual treatment plan and consultant. No automatic 3-monthly CT/TAP or tumour-marker surveillance is specified. Response imaging during neoadjuvant treatment is separately planned; postoperative surveillance follows the selected pathway.
monitoring.ecg: The source TESTS section does not explicitly prescribe a baseline ECG. Any baseline ECG recommendation needs separate cardio-oncology attribution.
monitoring.blood: NCCP p4 lists FBC/renal/liver before each cycle. Day8 FBC is needed to apply the explicit Day8 count rule (p5); do not misattribute weekly full chemistry to the printed tests list.
monitoring.completion: p4 does not explicitly add an end-of-course echo; later monitoring follows selected postoperative HER2 source.

00775.indication: Neoadjuvant adult high-risk HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer.
00775.sequence: Six 21-day cycles → surgery/pathology → separately selected adjuvant HER2 therapy (e.g. trastuzumab or T-DM1 as appropriate) to complete one year. No planned Day 15 paclitaxel.
00775.schedule: Pertuzumab/trastuzumab IV and carboplatin AUC6 on Day1; paclitaxel 80 mg/m² on Days1 and8. Paclitaxel reductions 80→70→60 mg/m²; carboplatin AUC6→5→4.
00775.eligibility: Age≥18, HER2 positive, ECOG0–1, adequate organ function, LVEF≥55% or ≥50% after completed anthracyclines. Baseline ANC<1.5 is excluded; severe hepatic impairment excludes paclitaxel.

support.risk: Day1 high (carboplatin AUC6); Day8 low (paclitaxel alone). Antibodies minimal. Postoperative risk follows selected medicine; do not label unknown T-DM1/other ADC as minimal.
support.premedication: First paclitaxel: dexamethasone8mg IV, chlorphenamine10mg IV, famotidine20mg IV 30min before. Day8 onward no routine dexamethasone unless consultant adds for reaction/risk; chlorphenamine continues and famotidine may be omitted only with consultant guidance when no reaction. Reconcile overlapping antiemetic steroids.
support.gcsf: May be required; local policy. Not universally mandatory.

administration.detail: Both antibodies before chemotherapy. Pertuzumab first60min+60min observation, subsequent30min+30–60min observation (not required after3 tolerated treatments). Trastuzumab first90min, later30min; observation6h from first start,2h from subsequent starts. Paclitaxel60min D1/D8 via non-PVC and0.22micron filter; carboplatin30min D1. Local observation deviations documented.

cardiac_rule.during_treatment: Hold HER2 therapy if current LVEF<50% AND decrease≥10 percentage points. Review/repeat after about3weeks; abnormal historical baseline is not a new current measurement.
cardiac_rule.heart_failure: 00258 says consider discontinuation, cardiology and clinical decision; other four sources say discontinue for symptomatic heart failure.

renal_rule.carboplatin: GFR≤20: do not administer. >20–30: extreme caution. CrCl<60: increased myelosuppression risk. Estimated dosing requires creatinine within48h; isotope-derived dose may persist only when current creatinine≤110% reference. Confirm method/recency rather than infer.

haematology.day1: ANC≥1 andplatelets≥75 permits table100%; ANC<1 and/orplatelets<75 delayuntilrecovery,max2weeks.

hepatic_rule.paclitaxel: Transaminases<10 andbilirubin≤1.25: no reduction;bilirubin1.26–2:75%original;2.01–5:50%original. Transaminases≥10and/orbilirubin>5:contraindicated. Decimalgaps require clarification, not rounding; lowercurrentdosemustnotbeautomaticallyraised.

nonhaematologic.paclitaxel: Neuropathy≥2 firstoccurrence:decrease10mg/m²;persisting/second:another10mg/m². Othergrade2toxicity:holduntil≤grade1thenreduce10. Broad≥grade3reactionrow saysdiscontinue andoverlaps neuropathyrow:holdandclarify ratherthanunqualifiedrestart. Unabletotolerateafter2reductions:cliniciandiscussion.

00258.title: Docetaxel, Carboplatin and Trastuzumab (TCH) – 21 days

monitoring.baseline: Source TESTS p4 lists cardiac function by echo/MUGA "if clinically indicated", while ELIGIBILITY p4 requires a baseline LVEF threshold. Reconcile this textual discrepancy explicitly; a baseline LVEF is needed to assess HER2 eligibility, supported separately by HER2/cardio-oncology guidance.
monitoring.ongoing: Echo/MUGA every 12 weeks; 4–8 weeks may be appropriate if cardiac impairment. At 21-day cycles, first planned 12-week echo is around cycle 5 if uninterrupted. Surgery does not reset this clock.
monitoring.imaging: NCCP leaves disease monitoring to the individual treatment plan and consultant. No automatic 3-monthly CT/TAP or tumour-marker surveillance is specified. Response imaging during neoadjuvant treatment is separately planned; postoperative surveillance follows the selected pathway.
monitoring.ecg: The source TESTS section does not explicitly prescribe a baseline ECG. Any baseline ECG recommendation needs separate cardio-oncology attribution.
monitoring.blood: p4 says regular FBC/renal/liver profile without explicit frequency; chemotherapy Day1 count/dosing tables require current review before treatment.

00258.indication: Adjuvant HER2-positive early breast cancer; node-positive or high-risk node-negative, ECOG0–2.
00258.sequence: Surgery → six21-day TCH cycles → trastuzumab alone to complete one year from first dose (usually18q21-day doses total). Radiation when indicated is coordinated after chemotherapy and may overlap antibody continuation if agreed. Endocrine treatment only if HRpositive; not automatic.
00258.schedule: Docetaxel75mg/m² and carboplatin AUC6 Day1 q21days ×6. Trastuzumab may be q21-day IV(8→6mg/kg), weekly IV(4→2mg/kg during chemotherapy then6mg/kg q21days), or600mg SC q21days. These are alternatives.
00258.eligibility: HER2positive, nodepositive/high-risk node-negative, ECOG0–2. Source baseline LVEF>55%, with clinical judgement at50–55%. Neuropathy≥2 is a CAUTION here rather than TCHP exclusion.

support.risk: TCH combination high; trastuzumab-only continuation minimal.
support.premedication: Docetaxel dexamethasone8mg orally twice daily for3days from day before; minimum3doses pretreatment. Consultant may consider20mg IV if oral course missed. No routine antibody premedication unless previous hypersensitivity.

administration.detail: Three distinct trastuzumab options; IV infusion observation6h from first start and2h subsequent; SC fixed600mg2–5min, alternating thighs,30min first/15min subsequent observation. Cytotoxic infusions remain IV. Weekly IV schedule changes appointment burden.

cardiac_rule.during_treatment: Hold HER2 therapy if current LVEF<50% AND decrease≥10 percentage points. Review/repeat after about3weeks; abnormal historical baseline is not a new current measurement.
cardiac_rule.heart_failure: 00258 says consider discontinuation, cardiology and clinical decision; other four sources say discontinue for symptomatic heart failure.

renal_rule.carboplatin: GFR≤20: do not administer. >20–30: extreme caution. CrCl<60: increased myelosuppression risk. Estimated dosing requires creatinine within48h; isotope-derived dose may persist only when current creatinine≤110% reference. Confirm method/recency rather than infer.

haematology.ongoing: Printed ANC>1.5 and platelets>100:100%. ANC1–1.49 and platelets>100:75% or100% with chosen G-CSF strategy. ANC<1 or platelets<100:delay until ANC>1.5 and platelets>100; then selected strategy. Exact1.5/exact100 and decimal gap1.49–1.5 are unassigned and require clarification.
haematology.febrile_neutropenia: Acute FN is an urgent hold; historical episode plus count recovery determines subsequent strategy: first75% previous dose or100% withG-CSF; second50% original or75% withG-CSF; third discontinue/switch toG-CSF or50% withG-CSF. No restart from event count alone.

hepatic_rule.docetaxel: AST/ALT≤1.5 withALP≤5, orAST/ALT>1.5–2.5 withALP≤2.5: no modification. AST/ALT>2.5–5 withALP≤2.5, orAST/ALT>1.5–5 withALP>2.5–5:75→60mg/m². Bothaxes>5:delaymax2weeks thenstop ifnotrecovered. A singleaxis>5 not explicitlymapped:review. Abnormalbilirubin:delaymax2weeks;stopchemoifnotrecovered. Source generally delays companion drugs with hepatic docetaxel delay but expressly allows trastuzumab continuation in bilirubin paragraph:document componentdecision.

nonhaematologic.neuropathy: Grade>2:docetaxel75→60mg/m²;persistingat60:discontinue. Grade≥2baseline is exclusion in00722/00731, caution only in00258.
nonhaematologic.stomatitis: Grade≥3:75→60; ifpersists60→50; no further planned reduction.

monitoring.blood: FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle (p4). Subsequent antibody-only phase follows its separately selected regimen.

00722.indication: Neoadjuvant adult high-risk HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer.
00722.sequence: Six21-day chemotherapy/dual-HER2 cycles → surgery/pathology → source lists trastuzumab q21 days for12 more cycles to complete one year from first dose. Contemporary residual-disease treatment selection requires the separate postoperative NCCP regimen; do not automatically continue pertuzumab or chemotherapy.
00722.schedule: Docetaxel75mg/m² and carboplatin AUC6 Day1 q21 days ×6. Pertuzumab840mg IV load then420mg q21days. Trastuzumab8mg/kg IV load then6mg/kg q21days.
00722.eligibility: HER2positive, ECOG0–1, adequate organ function, baseline LVEF≥55% (no post-anthracycline50% exception printed). Baseline ANC<1.5, neuropathy≥2, significant hepatic dysfunction, uncontrolled hypertension and relevant cardiac disease are exclusions.

support.risk: Combination phase high (carboplatin); trastuzumab-only continuation minimal.
support.premedication: Docetaxel dexamethasone8mg orally twice daily for3days beginning one day before; minimum3doses pretreatment. Missed oral course: consultant may consider20mg IV immediately before; do not self-substitute. Reconcile with antiemetic steroids. Antibody premedication only when indicated by previous reaction.
support.gcsf: Primary prophylaxis should be considered, not universally mandated (p1).

administration.detail: Pertuzumab first60min+60min observation; trastuzumab first90min, subsequent30min, observed6h from first start/2h subsequent starts. Docetaxel60min and carboplatin30min. Confirm local visit duration and observation; a SC trastuzumab component does not turn this into a Phesgo injection.
